result.topic_en: Notes on invariant theory: determining which functions are entire, finding systems of ternary linear forms analogous to Gordan's systems of quadratic forms, finding all one-to-one transformations of space, applying the transfer process to a covariant expression, and a remark that even infinitely many forms have a finite system of invariants.

items.english: Just as Gordan finds systems of special quadratic forms through the requirement that the second transvectants vanish, or become equal, or equal up to sign, one should look for systems of ternary linear forms where similar conditions are imposed on the bilinear invariants
